curriculum: Salesforce PD1 - Process Automation and Logic

learning_events.detail: Learner initially stated that Apex has bulkification built in.

learning_events.evidence: Learner correctly distinguished record volume from SOQL/DML operation volume and proposed collection-based processing.

learning_events.detail: Learner initially confused returned record count with SOQL query count.
Learner independently constructed basic and parent-relationship SOQL.

learning_events.evidence: Learner distinguished Flow entry criteria from transaction boundaries and identified asynchronous execution as a deferral mechanism.

learning_events.detail: Learner lacks complete model of Flow interview state, collection scope, and cross-interview database bulkification.

mastered: declarative vs programmatic automation conceptual scope

session_takeaways: Bulkification is a design principle, not an automatic property of Apex.
Record volume and platform-operation volume are distinct.
Multiple automation components do not necessarily create separate transactions.
Asynchronous execution changes transaction timing and can introduce eventual consistency.
Flow interview scope and bulk database behavior need explicit study.
